book.title: MATYU Kamambuno wakai Matyu muno boglkwa

content: Jon Baptais sigeglkwa
Herot,
Galili makan gavman moglkwa enge Yesus kamo digo ye pirtre,
ana ye kongunmo yomba ditongwa, “Jon Baptais kaima goglkwa ikra andigl ukor ongwa, yeglpre, yombuglomo kaneta paitongo kimagl kanekane orkwa.”
Herot eremogl Jon akegidi mogl kanesi ipi kane yungu endungwa. Sraglpre yene angigle Pilip embiye Herodias pre munduwo pango orkwa.
Sraglpre okuna Jon ka yegl ditongwa, “Ene ambu wike ina etnga i lo paikrumere etnga.”
Ye eremogl Jon sigoragledi prukwa, ba ye yomba kundutno goglkwa, sraglpre, Jon propet ta moglme dingwa.
Herot mam kugl yongwa engemo yongo ana yomba Herot bogl makaisi meglkwa. Herodias ambuglo ye kagle engre tongo, Herot wakai yene kandre munduwo argan orkwa.
Ye ka dipandigl ambai tongwa, “Na ka kaima yene digi, ene taragl ta pre dinatnga, taragl i pra ene tenaglka.”
Ana ambai mam eremogl ambuglo kina si endungo ye pi ka yegl dungwa, “Etne keunde Jon Baptais bre gare plet mina tembe yei iyu magl ya naro.”
Yegl dungo king Herot i pirtre munduwo kinde orkwa, ba ye yombamo meglmara mambro mina digi digra wedi pre ana angai gogl dinagledi ambai dumere mere kimbirnem yegl eriyo diendungwa.
Ana ye pi Jon kane yungu suna moglmara nungo garsire
ana ye bre plet mina tembe yei, ana kimbirnem ipi ambai teingo ana ambai ipi mam tongwa.
Ana Jon disaipelma wagle wu nangiye kake ipi maugl si pandigl, ana ye pi Yesus diteingwa.
Yesus yomba 5,000 kaiya mokna tongwa
Ana Yesus prukwa Jon sigeglme digo, dumo i kindekondo ye yene bot indre ende makan waule ongwa. Ana yomba ye ende omedigo pirtre, ye tauno tau kondo makandle ye omara eingwa.
Yesus bot mina ende atne wu, ana yomba merkinde meglkwa kandre, ye mitno gogl ana yomba kindeno erewakai ere tongwa.
Ana pokndungo disaipelma wagle ye moglmara wu yegl dingwa, “Kamun igle makan waule kra ande bena orkwa. Ene yomba prapra diendo, ye ende yungu epigl pi ana yene kaiya moknano topo eraglkwa.”
Yesus yegl ditongwa, “Ye ta ende enaglkwa paikrukwa. Enene taragl ninaglkwa ta indre ye teiyo.”
Ye di ikine endingwa, “No taragl merkinde ta yeikrukwa, bret 5 yongo
te fis suwo yongwa.”
Ana Yesus dungwa, “Yu na moglmara ya wiyo.”
Ana ye dungo yomba kugl wagle amedi meglko, Yesus bret 5 ya te fis suwo indre kan mitna heven ende God diwakai yeite ana bret bukondi disaipelma wagle tongo ye indre yumbusi yomba teingwa.
Ye prapra neingwa kuno orko ana ikine yoko yongwa. Disaipelma wagle gande imakaisi gagl basket 12 gre kau singwa.
Ana yomba neingwa yagl keunde kerikwa 5,000 orkwa, ba ambu ya gak ta kerekrikwa.
Yesus nigl bolamugl konbauna ongwa
Yesus tambre kana disaipelma wagle diendungo ende bot mina suna pindre okuna kana ende nigl mongo koglo imbo enapre eingo ana Yesus yene yomba prapra di perepere ende moglkwa.
Ana yomba prapra endpi kondigo, yene mundu makan muglo kamange era pre ende egli ongwa. Yene mundu moglko mim pangwa.
Ana enge igle bot ende nigle miniye suna ongo, ana ye enaglmara ir pond mange ana nigl pembigl di wu bot sungwa.
Ana kamun tange ungo, Yesus ye nigl bolamugl engre pi disaipelma wagle eimara plau dungwa.
Ana ye nigl bolamugl konbauna ongo disaipelma wagle ye kandre, kundugl pond gogl kaglkane ere ana ye dingwa, “I gigl ta!”
Ba Yesus oglandi ye ditongwa, “Ene nomano gigle dinano. I na winga. Ene kundugl goglkriyo.”
Ana Pita di ikine ende tongwa, “Yaglkande, ene kaima unga panan, ana ene dimin na nigl bolamugl engre unara i unaglka.”
Yesus ditongwa, “Ana wo!” Dungo Pita bot kondo ende atne wu nigl bolamugl Yesus umara ongwa.
Ba ye pindre kangwa ir kande ungo kundugl gogl, ana ye mambuno bogl ende nigl atne pindre kaglkane orkwa, “Yaglkande, na akepledo!”
Yesus oglandi yene ongo duglosi Pita ongo ake i-mitna ende ana yegl dungwa, “Ene pirngi dinga kembra pangwa ene sraglpre noman suwo yene?”
Ana ye akiye ende bot mina suna embriko ir bu yongwa.
Ana bot mina disaipelma wagle ye yange mangidi dembiye karaugl ere te yegl dingwa, “Kaima yene ene God Wam motnga.”
Genesaret kamun yomba kinde sungwa Yesus erewakai orkwa
Ye niglmong siprak si ende Genesaret kamun wingwa enge,
ana igle makan nem wagle Yesus ongo kandre, ka di dumo koglkoglo endigo, yomba pirtre kinde sungwa yomba prapra auro iyu Yesus moglmara wingwa.
Ana ye eremogl Yesus diteingwa, “Ene kan winge etn, kinde sungwa yomba ye ene gatn suna olto punduno akenaglkwa.” Ana prapra Yesus gaglmo akingwa mere kindeno argan orkwa.

footnotes.text: Yagl Herot i kangiye ta, Antipas pangwa ana ye Galili distrik sugl moglkwa. Ana okuna King Herot kande moglkwa enge Maria eremogl Yesus kugl yongwa. Kingmo Herot i wam erme Herot Antipas moglkwa. Matyu numa 2 mina kano.
Juda yomba bret gaglkwa i pond kaima ta manga. Nono skon gaunere yegl kuno, ana bret 5 i yomba suwo keunde nembir kuno erambuka.
